structure: Part 11, Port of entry and transit countries, read at repos/trade-imports-animals-frontend main 4c2119da. Read in full: journeys/linear/features/transport/page.js (seven transport page ids and slugs; only port-of-entry and transit-countries are this part's), evaluation.js (the transport feature's nine field-to-obligation bindings), copy/copy.en.js and copy/copy.cy.js (only the portOfEntry and transitCountries trees claimed; Welsh checked for key parity and marked machine-draft), port-of-entry/ (controller, template, arrival-window.js, validate.js) and transit-countries/ (controller, template, _added-countries-table.njk, rows.js, remove-action.js, validate.js), and fit/arrival-transit.fit.spec.js (37 tests in 10 describe blocks, including two generated by the out-of-window loop) with its fit/axe.js helper. To read the validators' blank handling and the default 'Select a valid option' message, lib/validate/validators.js, calendar.js formatDateText and shared/copy.en.js validatorDefaults were looked up but not claimed beyond what these two pages show; the transitedCountries gate in obligations/sections/transport.js was read only to explain the transit page's routing (part 2 owns the obligation model). Pages covered: the port of entry page at /port-of-entry, headed 'Arrival details', which collects arrival date at port (MoJ date picker with a 7-days-before to 6-months-ahead window), port of entry (type-ahead over the ports list), means of transport (select), transport identification and transport document reference (58-character caps); and the transit countries page at /transit-countries, an add-one-at-a-time list of up to 12 countries with per-row Remove, a live status region and a limit message. Neither page has an arrival time field and the transit page has no yes/no question, though the part's covers name both: each is recorded as a gap.

claims.statement: Every field on the port of entry page may be left blank when saving: none of the five has a required-field error on this page.
claims.quote:
Joi.string()
      .allow('')
      .valid('', ...values)
claims.note: Inferred from the validators the page composes (dateTextInRange, oneOf, maxText), each of which allows the empty string. Whether a blank answer blocks submission is the obligation model's concern: arrivalDateAtPort, portOfEntry, meansOfTransport, transportIdentification and transportDocumentReference are each declared mandatory there (part 2).

  scalar({ field: 'arrivalDateAtPort', obligation: arrivalDateAtPort }),
